message: 明日への一歩

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, isn't that pot over there done yet?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, looks like it」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then get the bento boxes ready」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll hurry up and make the stir-fry」

name: Synn
message: 「Roger~」

name: Synn
message: 「Something wrong?」

name: Macaron
message: 「That apron really does suit you」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, of course!」

name: Synn
message: 「It looks really good on you too, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aww, stop it, that's obvious♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey, if you look away while cooking, you're gonna hurt yourself, ya know?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I won't, I won't, I'm totally fine」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe... She's planning to hurt the Demon Lord instead」

name: Macaron
message: 「Muu... Lord Paqy, you meanie!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kabutaku!」

name: Macaron
message: 「A proper bride would never do something like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Bweh!? B-Bride...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yep. My next goal is to become Big Brother's proper bride!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, you aim to be a wonderful husband, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Husband, huh... I'll do my best...」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, why are you guys suddenly making bentos?」

name: Sally
message: 「Could it be... are you going on a picnic somewhere?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, something like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Just a quick trip to the Demon World」

name: Sally
message: 「The Demon World!? That won't be fun at all! There's nothing there!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I made a promise with Big Brother, after all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's right. I have to go greet Macaron's parents」

name: Macaron
message: 「Is that the main reason...?」

name: Synn
message: 「As your husband, yes」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course, I'm also going to meet Macaron's parents as the Demon Lord」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah... you're right!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm counting on you, Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Leave it to me!」
There's no way any parent could ever hate their own child.
I'll definitely clear up the misunderstanding between Macaron and her parents!
And then, surely, waiting just beyond that...
A sparkling new life will be waiting for us!

name: Paqy
message: 「Jeez, I'm worried about what lies ahead...」

name: Synn
message: 「With such a wonderful bride by my side, there's no way I could be worried」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez, dummy!」
Saying that, she gives a little twirl right on the spot.

name: Macaron
message: 「Do I look like a bride?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. You're completely adorable!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hehehe. You look pretty cool too, Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, thanks for that」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ahh, man, do whatever the hell you want...」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm hungry!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I made some for Sally-chan too, so wait just a second」

name: Synn
message: 「Once the bentos are ready, we're off to the Demon World, huh」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah!」
We still have so many things we need to do.
Step by step, steadily, I'll overcome them hand in hand with Macaron.
It doesn't matter how long it takes.
Because from now on, we'll always be walking the same path together.

name: Macaron
message: 「All right then, off we go to the Demon World!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah!」
Those footsteps, never tiring. Never parting. Forever onward…….
